Ad Formats

Pop
Push

Pop Ads

Popunder, Pop, and NewTab are among the highest revenue-generating ad formats available.
  • A fullscreen ad that appears in a new browser tab 
  • Supported by every device with 100% fill rate
  • Very high & stable revenue and CPM. 
  • Works with Adsense, video, banners and other formats.

Push notifications 

A fully compliant format suitable for any website
  • Works seamlessly with other ad formats
  • Doesn't take space on your website 
  • Provides passive revenue from users who stopped visiting your website but are still subscribed to it
  • Requires a one-time subscription approval 
  • Suitable for website owners and affiliates who own landing pages. 

Inpage push (floating banner)

A sliding banner that resembles push notifications
  • Minimal website space-consuming format yet highly visible 
  • Displays like a regular banner - no subscription needed
  • Fully customizable, friendly-looking
  • Supported by every device and browser 

Interstitial 

High engagement skippable format 
  • High CTR and payouts 
  • Overlaps website content 
  • Great user experience 
  • Works on every device and with any other format 

Content Locker / Link Shortener

Restrict access to sections of your website until visitors complete the required tasks.
  • Mostly suitable for social media that allow external links (YouTube, Telegram, Twitter)
  • Fully customizable format in terms of its design and content
  • Simple integration 
  • High revenue 

Smartlink

A direct URL that matches every traffic type
  • Best for remnant, redirect, and exit traffic
  • 100% fill rate
  • Our engine will show the best offer to the user

Direct link 

A direct URL that can be attached to any clickable element on your website
  • Link to every asset on your website
  • Our engine will show the best offer to the user
  • Opens on a new tab or redirects when clicked on
